simple.meaning: הֵד (hêd) is a Hebrew word meaning “a shout.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.summary: הֵד (hêd) / H1906 is traced through Ezekiel 7:7 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H1906. hed הֵד noun [masculine] id., only Ezek 7:7 הָרִים הֵד (joyous) shout on mountains (opposed to מְהוּמָה noise of battle ).

occurrences.englishText: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.
